name: Legacy header with team image
purpose: Introduce the people behind a service: a large serif statement, supporting paragraph and review badges beside a square team photo.
description: A hairline (#00251e, no top line) 2-column card with no gap: left cell holds a serif H2 (4rem/1.1 at every width), a 16px ink paragraph and a row of 4 review badges (h 4rem, 3rem <=479); right cell is a square team photo. Padding 5rem 2.5rem (3rem 1.5rem <=991, 1.5rem <=767); stacks to one column <=767. Not the page H1 (it follows the centred legacy hero on /lms/professional-services). No variants, no theme prop.
